title: Anna P Possible NDE 9127
content: My brother was sleeping on the adjacent bed, and my parents were sleeping in the next room. The room was well-lit because a street light was shining in the window. I tried to go to sleep, but couldn't because my heart was hurting a lot. It felt like it was working with effort, as if there were some weight on it. I did not attach a lot of meaning to this pain. I thought that I would simply fall asleep and by morning it would all pass. I was lying on my back, trying to breathe calmly. Then I felt weightless and was floating upward. I watched as I gently began to exit from my body. My Spirit looked like dense fog. I felt and knew that I was coming out of my body because my heart was not beating and my body was not breathing. At first, I wasn't afraid. I was just experiencing leaving my body. But then I understood that if I left my body completely and entirely severed the connection to it, then I would not be able to return to it. I wanted to visit my parents, flying to them as a Spirit, but I understood that they would not be able to see me in this state. I knew that my voice was part of my body and not part of me. A body can't call out when it has no breath. I felt regret that there was so much I had not done and that I was leaving so soon. I started to think about how I could return to my body before the final connection was severed. I decided that I had to force my body to breathe. I felt that if I summoned the strength from my Spirit and directed it at my body and commanded my body to take a breath, that my heart, having received oxygen and the strength of the Spirit's energy, would start to beat. It took tremendous effort to force my body to take a breath. I remember that I was concentrating only on this and was commanding my body to take a breath. During this I was strengthening this command with the will of the Spirit. After some time, it worked. My body took a sharp breath and my heart starting beating. I slowly and gently started going back into my body. I felt fine, calmed down and fell asleep. For a long time, I could not tell my parents about this, because it was so hard to talk about. It was different from what they taught in the Orthodox church. Memories of the event are still like a surprising, unexpected experience in the human body. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: September 1997 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) My heart was not beating and I was not breathing. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. It was just like when I was alive. There were no distortions or illusions, just reality. In addition, there was Spiritual vision. For example, Spirit vision showed what was happening in the next room. I clearly left my body and existed outside it. How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. My Spirit continued to think and be aware of all surroundings, with the additional understanding that my body was dead. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The same as while alive. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Additionally, I visually saw through the wall into my parents' bedroom Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The same Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt carefree, surprise at the unexpectedness of what was happening, regret that it was not time, and I had a desire to return. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I realized that I had not yet done all that I wanted and therefore came back to this world God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Jehovah's Witness Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes All religions are used by some people to control others. There are no religions in the Spiritual World. What is your religion now? Other faiths- Unitarian and other liberal faiths. I believe in an Intelligent Universe and that we are all Beings of energy Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. It did not correspond with the teachings of the orthodox church Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I did not believe in the existence of the Spirit before Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes. I was aware that I had existed before being incarnated in this body on this planet During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes. We are all part of the same thing; we are interconnected. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes we are here by our own free will and not by some accident During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes. We each have our own goal and mission. But, we are all united by a single goal to make the world better for the Good of the Universe During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? I was uncertain if an afterlife exists. I was distinctly aware that the death of the body is not the death of the Spirit Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Yes we all arrive with a concrete goal, each with our own. During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes. In the Spirit world there is no envy, lies, aggression, or malice. We treat one another with unconditional love. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I understood that the Spirit is what's real. The body is temporary. With time, I remembered how I first entered into my body, through the body of my mother, when the embryo of my earthly body was in my mother's womb. This does not happen at the moment of conception, but at the moment when the body of the child is formed, but the heart is not yet beating. And just then, the powerful energy of the soul entering the body causes the heart to start up and begin to beat. I remember being in my mother's belly and the feelings I had. I also knew what my mother was feeling and what she was doing. I told my mother about this and she confirmed it. I have started to have extra-sensory perception and healing abilities. More than once I have had premonitions of events that came true. My Spiritual vision is getting stronger. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. It's just the life of the Spirit, outside of the body this is normal Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Healing abilities, clairvoyance, lucid dreams, Spiritual vision have become stronger Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I understood who I really am. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Several years have gone by. It's hard for them to believe. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain I am not sure if I knew something about it. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Because when your Spirit leaves your body, there's no mistaking it What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. It was a real experience At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? A person continues to think and understand everything in the same way as during life. Only a more expanded understanding of things. We need to show more love toward people

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She feared that if she left her body completely and severed the final connection, she would not be able to return; she also regretted leaving “so soon” and felt she had not done all she wanted.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: Christian – Jehovah’s Witness. After: Unitarian and other liberal faiths.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported “Spiritual vision” including seeing through a wall into parents’ bedroom and awareness of next room.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with awareness of impending irreversible separation, then deliberate effort to breathe/restore heartbeat and return to body; no tunnel/light/beings/other realm reported.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She described her “Spirit” as “dense fog” and reported forcing her body to breathe by directing the will/energy of the Spirit, after which the body took a sharp breath and the heart started beating.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My Spirit looked like dense fog.”; “I felt and knew that I was coming out of my body because my heart was not beating and my body was not breathing.”; “I decided that I had to force my body to breathe.”; “My body took a sharp breath and my heart starting beating.”
